list.title: Campaigns
list.description: Every survey the CRM texts out, grouped by business. Counts follow the period you pick; the sparkline always shows the last 14 days.
list.emptyDescription: This business has no survey campaigns yet. Pick another business or clear the filter.

detail.sampleLinkHint: Opens a pending link from a demo persona's inbox, as the customer would see it
detail.sampleLinkNone: No demo persona has a pending link for this campaign right now
detail.trendDescription: Answers per day with the average rating.
detail.distributionDescription: Every answered question in the period, 1 to 5.
detail.questionsDescription: Mean score and spread for each question. Skipped means the customer left that question unrated.
detail.byBranchDescription: Links sent in the period and how many were answered.
detail.noBranches: No links were sent in this period.
detail.commentsDescription: Shown exactly as the customer wrote them.
detail.noCommentsHint: Comments are optional; most customers just tap the stars.
detail.notFoundDescription: The link may be old or the id mistyped. Pick a campaign from the list instead.

settings.title: Survey settings
settings.description: Read-only. The questions, the link lifetime and the sender ID are set in the CRM that issues the links.

links.title: SMS log
links.description: Every survey link the CRM has texted, with its live status. Links expire on their own when their time runs out.
links.openLinkHint: Opens the survey exactly as the customer would
links.emptyDescription: Try another status tab, clear a filter or search for fewer digits.
